theorems.name: Submission.codim1_lur_no_det_cons_normal_decomp
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (ν w : Euclid (n + 1)) (σ : Fin n → Euclid (n + 1)), ‖ν‖ = 1 → Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range σ) = (Submodule.span ℝ {ν})ᗮ → Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun r c : Fin (n + 1) => (Fin.cons w σ : Fin (n + 1) → Euclid (n + 1)) c r) = inner ℝ w ν * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun r c : Fin (n + 1) => (Fin.cons ν σ : Fin (n + 1) → Euclid (n + 1)) c r)
